summary: Todd Ermentraut fell into a tree well skiing the back bowls of Vail, breaking his femur; trapped with no way out until two passing skiers heard his cries, stabilized him until Vail Ski Patrol arrived ~35 min later; survived.
location: back bowls of Vail Mountain, Vail ski area
notes: Date approximate: November 2018 ('last November' per the 2019-02-04 article); listed as first of month. In-bounds ski-area incident, same class as indexed ids 3282 and 3469. INSERT run977.
